name: Why I Do This
controllingIdea: Purpose-driven work creates meaning for both the agent and those they serve.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: The question of 'why' is posed - why real estate?
narrativeArc.risingAction: Origin story or defining moments that shaped the path
narrativeArc.crisis: Moments of doubt, choice, or challenge to commitment
narrativeArc.climax: The realization of true purpose - what it really means
narrativeArc.resolution: Renewed commitment, invitation to share the journey

questions.question: How did you get into real estate? What's your origin story?
questions.placeholder: I was a corporate lawyer for 10 years before I realized...

questions.question: What moment or experience confirmed this was your path?
questions.placeholder: When I handed keys to a single mom who never thought she could own...

questions.question: Have you ever questioned this choice? What kept you going?
questions.placeholder: The first year was brutal. I almost quit after losing three deals in a row...

questions.question: What does this work mean to you beyond income?
questions.placeholder: I help people create stability, build wealth, make memories...

questions.question: What do you want people to know about working with you?
questions.placeholder: I'm not here to sell you a house. I'm here to help you find home...

promptConfig.systemContext: This is a purpose and authenticity piece. The agent shares their deeper motivations. This builds emotional connection and trust. It should feel genuine, not manufactured.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Heartfelt, genuine, not preachy. Share real motivations without sounding like a motivational poster. Let the passion show through specifics.

usageHints: Be specific - generic statements fall flat
Include a challenge or doubt for authenticity
Focus on client impact, not self-aggrandizement
Great for anniversaries or milestone moments

exampleScenarios.title: The Career Change
exampleScenarios.situation: Agent explains leaving previous career for real estate
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: I was a corporate accountant for 15 years. Good salary, boring work. When I helped my sister buy her first house, I felt more fulfilled in those 3 weeks than in 15 years of spreadsheets. I quit 6 months later.

expectedOutput.hook: 15 years in accounting. 3 weeks helping my sister. Everything changed.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: Fulfillment isn't found in spreadsheets. It's found in keys.
